name: WEB-T
description: Automated website content translation via WEB-T, including a European Commission eTranslation engine.
project_description:
With WEB-T, you can effortlessly expand your reach by translating both new and existing content into multiple languages without the need to learn any new, complicated editing interfaces.

Picture this: Your translated content is as flexible as regular content, making it a breeze to keep it accurate and up-to-date. Say goodbye to the frustration of cumbersome translation tools.

 

 Features 
 
 Automatic translatable entity (article, page, comment etc.) content re-translation on source entity create/update events. 
 Pre-translation of existing website content. 
 Free automatic translation in all European languages with eTranslation. 
 Support for custom machine translation providers. 
 Integration with existing Drupal localization functionality for page language switching and translation post-editing. 
 SEO support. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Configure translation languages, domains, and translatable content with Drupal core localization modules. 
 Add language switcher to your website. 
 Get MT provider access 
 Configure the WEB-T Drupal extension with your MT provider access data in Configuration > WEB-T Settings . 
 Translate content on new entity creation or pre-translate your existing website content. 
 Edit translated pages and articles as regular content. 
 
 Please note: Websites using WEB-T plugin with eTranslation integration enabled must be published and accessible online from eTranslation service. Translation with eTranslation will not work otherwise.

For more information please see WEB-T Drupal module instructions .

 Additional Requirements 
 WEB-T uses built-in Drupal localization modules:

 
 drupal:content_translation 
 drupal:locale 
 drupal:language 
 drupal:config_translation 
 
 More information 
 WEB-T enables seamless translation of your website's entire content into any language supported by compatible automated translation services. You can integrate your preferred service using APIs or opt for the free eTranslation service provided by the European Commission (EC).

While WEB-T itself is free, access to the eTranslation service and API key is limited to organizations and individuals within the European Union (EU) and its associated countries.

If you're located outside the EU and require translation services, you'll need to find a machine translation (MT) service provider compatible with the WEB-T API. Instructions on how to ensure compatibility with WEB-T APIs can be found here .

 For more information please see WEB-T official website or GitLab code repository .
